name: Warden
about: Shapes the fight. Plants totems that fight for you and roots enemies in place.

E.name: Totem
E.about: Plant a totem at the mouse. It fights with your weapon: Strikes the toughest foe (1.5x your Strike), or Sweeps when 3+ are close (0.75x your Sweep). Up to 2 at once.

F.name: Root Field
F.about: Enemies in a circle at the mouse are held in place.
